name: cx-goal-one-rule~p2
task: Try not to drop the key while the door is still closed. Open the door, then pick up the box in the other room.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: 'Try not to drop the key while the door is still closed' is a soft Absence(key_lost) — key_lost already encodes the loss before door_open condition, so no Precedence is needed. 'Open the door, then pick up the box' is captured by hard Existence(target_picked_up) with Precedence(door_open, target_picked_up), which also forces door_open; the hard Existence(door_open) is the one optional removal allowed, though harmless here.

texts: The agent attempts to avoid the event where the key was acquired and then lost before the door was opened.
The door leading to the target room becomes open at some point.
The mission's designated box is picked up at some point.
The door leading to the target room is opened before the mission's box is picked up.
